protocol.validation: Held-out real recording. Conditional refinement from the original project's top grid candidate and flight pair; not a blind search. Nothing is tuned on this recording. Truth (published/provenance.json evaluation_truth) is read only by the evaluate stage, after fits.json is complete.
protocol.P1: Reported velocities re-extracted from the raw archive into data/eagle-cam/traces-velocity.npz (scripts/extract_eagle_cam_velocity.py; inputs.json frame and bbox, archive SHA-256 checked).
protocol.P2: Layered weather: WeatherSeries.from_open_meteo(weather-open-meteo.json, geoid -24.231 m), saved as data/eagle-cam/weather-profile-geoid18.json; per-flight profiles at each event's heard CPA (WeatherSeries.for_events at the set's initial clock).
protocol.P3: Observer ellipsoid height for every fit -19.231 m (= -24.231 m geoid + 5.0 m above MSL).
protocol.P4: Start candidate: highest-score row of published/swfl_search_best_per_pair.csv (lat, lon, icao1, icao2, t_heard1, shift); dist_m is not read before evaluation.
protocol.P5: Published events: the ordered pair (i, j) of published/swfl_detected.json entries that satisfies the original search's pair filters for the winning row: v_k within +/-35 % of the row's v_k, row d_k within [0.4, 2.5] x event d_k, and (t_cpa_j - t_cpa_i) within 6 s of the row's heard-time difference (t_heard2 - t_heard1, t_heard2 = icao2's acoustic CPA at the row position, 343 m/s, P3 height), and the implied recording start t_heard1 - t_cpa_i within 120 s of the live stream's release_timestamp (recording.info.json). Expected unique; if several, the smallest timing mismatch. Section clock = recording - 17000 s. Event window = [t_start, t_end], cpa = t_cpa, f0, speed = v, distance = d, harmonics 2.
protocol.P6: Automatic events: detect_flyovers(whitened section, FlyoverOptions(), top=15). For each flight, its predicted heard CPA at the start candidate (the acoustic CPA nearest the flight's published event, 343 m/s, published-set initial clock); the detection nearest in heard time within 20 s. (The Oyster Bay scripts pick the highest z within 20 s; the brief says nearest; nearest is used and the highest-z choice is recorded.) A flight without a detection within 20 s is recorded and the automatic set has only what exists (one event: initial clock of the published set; none: no automatic fits).
protocol.start_and_calibration: As scripts/compare_oyster_bay.py: initial clock = t_heard1 - event1.cpa + shift; tracks = the covering segment of each ICAO trimmed to event window +/-120 s (velocity file); joint_score sweep at the fixed start (shared +/-4 s shift, 17 steps; per-event +/-12 Hz, 121 steps), once per atmosphere and event set.
protocol.F1: BASELINE constant/spline/ridge: ModelOptions(degree=1, smoothing='spline'), constant 343 m/s.
protocol.F2: PRIMARY layered/fused/ridge: ModelOptions(degree=1, velocity='fused'), layered atmosphere, spectrogram ridge, uncertainty=True.
protocol.F3: Full factorial atmosphere {constant 343 m/s, layered} x trajectory {spline, fused} x measurement {ridge, demod (reextract=2, noise='snr', hum='subtract')}; every cell uncertainty=True, keep_observations, evidence via assess_candidate.
protocol.F4: At each set's F2 solution: discover() over traces-velocity.npz (TraceIndex) with DiscoveryOptions() and, separately, max_distance = ground_range = 12 km; discovery scan atmosphere constant 343 m/s (as both Oyster Bay discovery scripts). Joint refit (F2 options, layered profiles for every event, uncertainty=True) of the F2 events + confirmed independent passes, start = F2 position/clock, f0 = F2 f0 + discovered f0; the discovered segment is taken from the velocity file and trimmed to its window +/-240 s (as discovery.trim_track). If the refit raises ValueError the weakest discovery is dropped and the refit retried (as discovery.joint_refit). No confirmations: no refit (recorded).
protocol.E1: Horizontal error of every fit; inside 50 % / 90 % region; normalised error sqrt(e^T C^-1 e).
protocol.E2: F1 vs F2 per event set; for each factor the paired cells (other factors fixed) it improved.
protocol.E3: Only then: the original project's top grid candidate, two-flyover and five-flyover refinements.
protocol.failures: A failing fit is an outcome and is reported; bugs are fixed and the whole plan rerun.

deviations: P5 event windows: this recording has no published measured windows (Oyster Bay used oyster_bay_ev1/ev2.json, 110 s); the published detection windows [t_start, t_end] (240 s) of swfl_detected.json are used as they are. Harmonics 2, as data/oyster-bay/events.json and the detector's events.

P5 pairing rule: the winning row stores only t_heard1, so the event pair is identified with the original search's own pair filters (speed +/-35 %, distance 0.4-2.5x, heard-time difference within 6 s) plus the implied recording start within 120 s of the stream's release time; see protocol P5.

P6: the brief says 'the detection nearest in heard time (within 20 s)' while the Oyster Bay scripts take the highest z within 20 s; the brief's nearest rule is used and the highest-z rank is recorded. top=15 detections as in both Oyster Bay detector scripts (function default is 10).
F1/F3 heights: every fit, constant and layered, uses the P3 height -19.231 m (Oyster Bay constant cells used -30 m); per the brief.

F4: one discovery round (no second confirmation scan at the refit); discovery scan atmosphere constant 343 m/s as in both Oyster Bay discovery scripts (the layered model has per-flight profiles only for fitted flights); TraceIndex over traces-velocity.npz (same 8190 segments as traces.npz) so discovered segments carry reported velocity for the fused refit.
notes: Truth exposure: before this plan was written, while reading the eagle-cam input preparation script in git history (commit 08b2b45, scripts/fetch_eagle_cam_example.sh) to learn the input conventions, the agent saw the evaluation_truth coordinates written into that script. No dist_m column and no README error was read, and no location error was computed. Every choice in this plan is the brief's frozen protocol or an Oyster Bay script precedent; the few the agent made (listed under deviations) were fixed without computing any error. The script itself reads the truth only in the evaluate stage.
The start candidate's coordinates (P4) are read by design.
